srs: The investigation assignment system records Complaint, Investigation, Investigator, and Evidence; each has an id attribute. Each Complaint can have zero or more Investigation records, and each Investigation belongs to exactly one Complaint. Each Investigation uses exactly one Investigator, and each Investigator serves zero or more Investigation records. Each Investigator manages one or more Evidence records by composition, and each Evidence belongs to exactly one Investigator. Each Complaint can reference zero or more Evidence records, and each Evidence can be referenced by zero or more Complaint records.
